articles.title: Police charge 33-year-old dump truck driver in collision that killed city traffic agent
articles.summary: Police say they've arrested and charged 33-year-old Brampton man in a collision that killed a Toronto traffic agent on Thursday.

articles.title: Portion of TTC Line 2 shut down twice due to trespasser at track level on Friday
articles.summary: A portion of Line 2 Bloor-Danforth came to a halt twice on Friday, causing delays for commuters first during the busy morning rush hour and then once again in the afternoon. articles.title: OPP officer charged with assault during arrest in Caledon: SIU
articles.summary: An Ontario Provincial Police officer who was involved in an arrest that left a man seriously injured in Caledon has been charged with assault.

articles.title: OPP officer charged with assault after Caledon man injured in arrest: SIU
articles.summary: An Ontario Provinical Police officer who was involved in an arrest that left a man seriously injured in Caledon last year has been charged with assault.

articles.title: Ontario government completes bike lane removal on section of Bloor Street W.
articles.summary: Bike lanes on a 1.2-kilometre stretch of Bloor Street West have been completely removed, according to the province Friday. It comes just weeks after dozens of residents came together in Etobicoke to protest the removal, which is the first part of Ontario's plan to rip out bike lanes on three major roads in Toronto.

articles.title: Walmart Canada launches AI shopping assistant Sparky
articles.summary: MISSISSAUGA — Walmart Inc. has brought its AI chatbot Sparky to Canada, more than a year after the retailer first rolled out the shopping assistant in the United States.

articles.title: 'We've had enough': Condo owners rally at Queen's Park to call for change in how condo boards operate
articles.summary: A group of condo owners took their fight for legislative change to Queen's Park this week to demand reforms they say would protect the 1.9 million people in Ontario who live in condos.

articles.title: How Brampton's youngest councillor plans to bring a 'generational' change to city hall
articles.summary: Sukhman Sangha, 29, became Brampton's youngest regional councillor following Monday's municipal election. Representing wards 9 and 10 on the city's northeast borders, he says he has strong plans to advocate for the community where housing and population growth are on the rise, but services haven't kept up.

articles.title: City traffic agent dead after being struck by driver of dump truck in Toronto, police say
articles.summary: A city traffic agent has died after being struck by a driver of a dump truck in the city's Thorncliffe Park neighbourhood Thursday, Toronto police say.
